meta.note: Updated with all 4 scenario variants (S1=baseline, S2=+micro, S3=+macro, S4=+micro+macro). top_models_by_company has the verified top-3 per company. company_scenario_metrics has all model×scenario combinations per company. best_model_per_company has the single best for quick lookups. Original baseline models remain in model_perf and company_metrics. company_metrics now includes scenario-specific models for per-company charts.

scenarios.S4: Engineered predictors + lagged micro + locked macro

meta.best_model_selection_metric: MAPE within each company/scenario; top company model chosen by lowest MAPE, then RMSE tie-break.
meta.q4_2025_correction_note: Historical Q4 2025 values were corrected to fiscal Q4 where the company has a non-calendar fiscal year. The previous JSON mixed fiscal year with calendar quarter, so fiscal Q4 values for companies such as Apple, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Visa, Peloton, Zoom, GameStop, Gap, and BlackBerry were stored in earlier 2025 rows.
meta.forecast_page_note: Forecast page data refreshed from best_models_4_scenarios_plus_best_time_series_by_company.csv and all forecast trajectories from backtest_models_merged_analysis.xlsx.
meta.actual_backtest_note: Latest actual values in historical/EDA were aligned to the actual_values fields from the verified best-model CSV.
